row.name: Children's Club House Daycare & Learning Center

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children did not have completed shot records in their files.    Note: Parents to both children sent in current copies of the shot records during my inspection making this corrected at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee: One caregiver has not signed off stating they have completed pre-service and orientation trainings.    Note: The caregiver signed the personnel form 2946.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))

occurrences.finding: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine: One child's immunization record does not have the doctor's signature and information on the record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine (26 TAC §746.623(2)(D))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two children's files have a parent listed as an emergency contact instead of an alternate adult.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the school age room: The boarder is coming off of the wall near where the cots are kept. The floor pannels are shifting causing large gaps. Paint is peeling along the back wall near the vending machines.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Accessible to Children: The school age children do not have individual cubbies or space for their personal belongings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Accessible to Children (26 TAC §746.2705(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: One caregiver does not have documentation showing that the meet the caregiver requirements.    Note: The caregiver completed the application information showing that they meet the requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): One caregiver does not have the pre-employment affidavit in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Two caregivers are missing the signed and notarized affidavit in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - signed dated statement that employee received operational policies: One caregivers file is missing documentation show that they received and reviewed the operational policies and personnel policies.    Note: The caregiver completed the personnel form 2947.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - signed dated statement that employee received operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: While outside on the playground the school age caregiver could not adequatly supervise the children as half the group were not within eye sight on the playground as they were on the other side of the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One caregiver is missing the topics under this standard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: The climbing structure was observed to have several spots where the metal was rusting and the protective covering was peeling away from the stairs and platform.    The boarder around the climbing structure is broken in several places causing sharp edges.    Note: The director and caregiver blocked the entire climbing structure and loose fill area off until they can get it repaired. This brought it into compliance during my inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose fill under and around the climbing structure was not 6 inches per required.    Note: The director and caregiver blocked off the area of the climbing structure and loose fill so no children can play in the area until repairs can be made. This brought it into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The caregivers and director do not have current CPR. Their CPR expired in June of 2025.    Note: The director informed me it was scheduled for 6/21/25; however, due to the AC breaking and repairs needed the class was set to be rescheduled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Follow up 11/14/24: There is still roach activity in the kitchen.    Note: Pest control has been twice since the last inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - height=depth: A free standing arch climber that does not have loose fill under or around the use zones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - height=depth (26 TAC §746.4901(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: Sign in and out logs were not readily available for a few of the caregivers and the director during my inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Vents in the toddler room were visibly dusty. A fan in the infant room was dusty.    Note: The vents were cleaned and the fan removed from the room during my inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Roach activity and live roaches were observed in the kitchen area.     Note: Pest control does come out regularly. Pest control was scheduled for Friday with a request for a different formula.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The emergency drill log could not be found during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation of Smoke Detectors: At least three of the smoke detectors were beeping indicating low batteries.    Note: The batteries were replaced during my inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation of Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.5317)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The air vents in the school age room were visibly dusty.    Note: The vents were dusted during my inspection. Pictures were taken of the dirty vents and clean vents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child's file out of six reviewed does not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
